title: Deduplicate shared callers by a selected value
prompt: The title catalog and config-value catalog already call unique with a key function. Please extend textkit.sequences.unique(items, key=None) so these callers work, while preserving its documented equality, order, original-object, and finite-iterable guarantees. Without key, behavior stays the same; with key, retain the first original item for each equal projected value. Projected values may be unhashable. Keep slug_catalog and value_catalog working according to their docstrings.
parts: Extend the shared unique helper with optional equality-based projection for both catalog callers.
